findings.claim: The brief is internally contradictory on the absent-ledger case. T2 prose says a crucible leg whose <wave>.screen.jsonl is absent renders 'screen: none - JEV screen not run', but the acceptance predicate AND crucible criterion require prompts/BP4-CRUX.md compiled WITHOUT a screen ledger to be byte-identical to master - and master (150 lines) has no screen text. Both cannot hold.
findings.resolution: Resolved in favor of the testable gate: absent ledger -> empty string (byte-identical to master, verified 11891==11891). The 'screen: none - JEV screen not run' sentinel is preserved but now renders when the ledger is PRESENT but has zero decision rows (verified). This keeps the sentinel reachable without breaking the byte-identical acceptance the crucible diffs.

for_ruling.question: Confirm the absent-ledger reconciliation: absent -> empty (byte-identical), present-but-empty -> 'screen: none - JEV screen not run'. If instead the sentinel must render on an ABSENT ledger for a crucible leg, the 'byte-identical to master' acceptance/crucible criterion must be relaxed, since master carries no screen text. Only one of the two can be true.
